island.title: Thornwood Hollow
island.rule: Light grows living bridges, bounce caps, and thorn walls that wilt in shadow, unlit woods rotate behind your back, and hollow stumps shrink you tiny.
island.feel: Eerie storybook woods that shift from creepy trap to botanical garden once you master hiding your own light.
island.arc: Learn Seedlight in Lantern Glade and steer the Shifting Woods. Clear the tiny Under Root and the silk Weaver's Loom in either order, stand trial in the Briar Court, earn Solar Beam inside the Hollow Oak, defeat Briar Matron, and face the Mother Root.
moments: Shrinking tiny and realizing your oversized lantern blooms thorn walls unless you hide it behind an acorn crate.
Bouncing one shot five times around a sideways glass jar to frost pin four fruits at once.
Freezing half a room's silk line blue while burning the other half so its fall hoists the Boss Key bridge.
Lighting Mercy or Fire after each Briar Court joust and seeing the next arena physically transform.
Darkening half an oak chamber on purpose so the unlit room rotates a locked vault right to your feet.

underroot.promise: A tiny world beneath the Great Stump where grass blades tower like cathedrals and your lantern burns like a miniature sun.
underroot.power: Sap Horn commands tame beetles to carry you across sap and halt on command.
underroot.arc: Learn to hide your bright lantern and focus dewdrop lenses, flip the Stag Colossus for Sap Horn, ride beetles across sap rivers, solve the glass Lantern Jar, and darken Hundred Lamps.
underroot.boss: Hundred Lamps is a ten segment centipede vulnerable only on dark rings. Hide your lantern behind pillars to cast shadow.

loom.promise: A suspended silk cathedral where blue light freezes hoist threads while yellow sparks race along linked webs to burn and bloom.
loom.power: Brass Shuttle lets your thrown lantern string a live fire silk wire from spools.
loom.arc: Learn silk firebreaks and frozen hoists, burn the Thread Keeper's curtain for Brass Shuttle, weave custom wires across void gaps, solve the Cathedral of One Thread, and face the Loom Widow.
loom.boss: The Loom Widow prowls a six spoke web over void. Ignite the rim spool of her spoke to drop her onto the center spindle.

briar_court.promise: A forest courtroom of three knight jousts where choosing Mercy or Fire after each duel physically rebuilds the next arena.
briar_court.arc: Place both relics before the forest jurors, unhorse Sir Taproot and Dame Spindle while casting two arena changing verdicts, and counterbalance the Briar Arbiter's scales to open the Hollow Oak.
briar_court.boss: The Briar Arbiter wields justice scales on your shaped arena. Use your verdict gift and counterbalance his scale pan.

hollow_oak.promise: A towering living tree uniting sap levels, rotating growth rings, tiny bark crawls, silk sparks, and the piercing Solar Beam.
hollow_oak.power: Solar Beam slices brambles, cracks masonry, and pierces obstacles in one line.
hollow_oak.arc: Learn the Sap Clock, win Solar Beam in the Heartwood Shrine, beat Elder Sporecap, spin the Sap Hub and dark rotating Moving Chamber, combine big and tiny scales, and defeat Briar Matron.
hollow_oak.boss: Briar Matron splits the floor into growth rings and snuffs the canopy. Vault spores, beam snares, and bloom the center.

overworld.aha: Your lantern blooms plants along the spine while hollow stumps and shifting clearings hide deeper paths.

Did blooming Seedlight plants along the path teach the rule naturally?
